title: A Message Problem
text:
Lucas sends a lot of text messages every day. He writes to his best friend, Ana, in the morning to say hello. Sometimes he sends a photo of his breakfast too. Yesterday, Ana did not answer for two hours, so Lucas called her.

Ana was on the bus, and her phone battery was low. When she got home, she wrote a long message to say sorry. She also sent a funny emoji with a smile. Now they are happy again, and they plan to meet at the park on Saturday.

questions.text: What did Lucas do because Ana did not answer for two hours?
Where do Lucas and Ana plan to meet on Saturday?
What does Ana probably want when she sends the long message?
options: To make things right with Lucas
To stop being friends with Lucas

questions.text: What can you infer about Lucas and Ana's friendship?

vocabulary.definition: short written notes sent from one phone to another
the part of a phone that gives it power
feeling or showing that you regret something you did
a small picture or symbol used in messages to show feelings

paragraph_translations: Lucas envía muchos mensajes de texto todos los días. Le escribe a su mejor amiga, Ana, por la mañana para saludarla. A veces también envía una foto de su desayuno. Ayer, Ana no respondió durante dos horas, así que Lucas la llamó.

Ana estaba en el autobús y la batería de su teléfono se estaba acabando. Cuando llegó a casa, escribió un mensaje largo para pedir perdón. También envió un emoji divertido con una sonrisa. Ahora están contentos otra vez y planean encontrarse en el parque el sábado.
